scope: Publication copies only; canonical local evidence is unchanged.
original_hash_semantics: canonical_sha256 is the hash of original recorded bytes. Hashes inside canonical audits, shared hash records and source inventories continue to refer to original evidence/fixture/source bytes. A normalized publication copy can have different bytes; publication_sha256 records those bytes explicitly.

normalizations.absolute_evidence_path_to_relative: Absolute host evidence file paths are made relative to this bundle.
normalizations.absolute_host_workspace: Personal absolute host workspace prefixes become <HOST_WORKSPACE>.
normalizations.absolute_host_home_prefix: Personal absolute macOS home prefixes become <HOST_HOME>, retaining path suffixes.
normalizations.public_pr_body_personal_home_prefix: One already-public PR body personal home prefix becomes <SOURCE_AUTHOR_HOME>; Linux container paths remain unchanged.

not_redacted: Numeric measurements, case IDs, revisions, image IDs, fixture/source hash values, public URLs and Linux container paths are retained. Public upstream author metadata and documented development JWT examples remain public source evidence.
retained_archive_metadata: archives/*-sha256.json are per-file source hash inventories, not downloaded source archives.

files.adaptation: Public-copy-only --recorded-fixtures offline reanalysis mode; default fixture-byte verification unchanged. Canonical analyzer and benchmark records were not modified.

files.origin: publication documentation generated for this bundle

self_hash: This manifest does not include a hash of itself.
